interpretation: The family sampler uses shuffled balanced queues, with eight frontier and two far draws per ten episodes before any learned band. Independent binomial count variance is not the correct reference for this sampling design.

Actual updates61-65 each contain the same twelve always-winning and twelve always-losing frontier families, with all far episodes dying. Many families produce multiple action sequences; maxima per update are659,638,602,648,680. Thus fixed outcomes and near-fixed total wins do not establish deterministic actions or failed random sampling.

Both retained checkpoints match their respective original GPU evaluations on all96 candidate sequences and outcomes. This does not reveal a current persistent cache difference in those evaluated roots.

A1729 final policy80 gives76/96, while its policy61 evaluation gave48/96. A2718 is a separate initialization. Those changed weights/initializations cannot be used as a same-policy cache-corruption experiment.

Neither the30M nor40M A1729 checkpoint was retained. Historical cache corruption versus historical policy behavior cannot be decisively separated from these later checkpoints. No historical action probabilities or entropy have been invented.
The existing historical action-probability/entropy logs aggregate frontier and far. The fresh k8-only metrics are separate diagnostics, not retrospectively reconstructed training telemetry.
No model, reward, hyperparameter, sampler, engine or cache code was changed as a result of this diagnosis.
